postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff + target module + existing tests loaded; handoff complete; baseline suite count recorded

m1.title: Resolve the gauge path from the composite binding key
m1.imperative: Rename resolve_gauge_path's second parameter from session_id to binding_key and update its docstring; call _spine_rail.binding_key(data) at the handle_post_tool_use call site, carrying the `_spine_rail is None` guard OUT to that call site so an import failure is a deliberate silent skip rather than an exception into the outer swallow. binding_key returning None means write nothing at all. TDD: write the new tests first and observe them red (attest c1), then implement to green (c2). New tests: a subagent bound under `session#agent` resolves ITS OWN gauge path while the parent bound under the bare session resolves its own (neither ambiguous); _spine_rail None writes nothing; an unresolvable identity writes nothing.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the new composite-key tests written and observed failing against the unmodified module

gauge path resolves from the composite key; parent and subagent each see exactly one candidate; _spine_rail-None and unresolvable-identity write nothing; every pre-existing test in tests/test_gauge_writer.py passes unedited

constraints: Allowed scope: scripts/hooks/gauge_writer_hook.py, tests/test_gauge_writer.py, a new fixture under tests/fixtures/ only.
scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py, scripts/gauge_reader.py, scripts/checklist_engine.py and docs/GAUGE_WRITER_HOOK.md are OUT of scope.
A payload with no agent_id must behave byte-identically to today; existing tests pass UNEDITED.

m2.title: Validate agent_id at this module's own boundary and derive its transcript path
m2.imperative: Add an ALLOWLIST agent_id check local to gauge_writer_hook.py (hex-ish token plus - and _), not a denylist extension of spine_rail's, because that denylist still admits `:`, `*` and `?` which all reach the agent-{agent_id}.jsonl interpolation on a Windows filesystem. Add the pure derivation helper Path(transcript_path).with_suffix('') / 'subagents' / f'agent-{agent_id}.jsonl'. A payload whose agent_id fails the check writes NOTHING - never a repaired or sanitized path, and never an exception into the outer swallow. TDD red (c1) then green (c2).

preconditions.statement: m1 complete: composite-key resolution in place

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the allowlist-rejection and derivation tests written and observed failing
a rejected agent_id character (including `:`, `*`, `?`) writes nothing anywhere; the derived path helper returns the confirmed on-disk shape

constraints: Allowlist, not denylist. A failing value means write nothing.
No exception may escape into handle_post_tool_use's outer except - the skip must be deliberate and visible.

m3.title: Fail closed: a subagent reads only its own derived transcript
m3.imperative: When the payload carries an agent_id, the reading comes from the derived transcript and ONLY from it - there must be no code path anywhere that passes the parent's transcript to compute_record while agent_id is present (the #202/#261 misattribution). If the derived file is absent, write a gauge-skip.json with reason 'subagent-transcript-missing' and return: no gauge.json, no gauge-uncalibrated.json. TDD red (c1) then green (c2). The fail-closed test asserts gauge.json is unchanged in BYTES and MTIME, plus the sidecar's reason.

preconditions.statement: m2 complete: derivation helper and allowlist in place

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the fail-closed tests written and observed failing
agent_id present + derived transcript absent leaves gauge.json byte- and mtime-identical, raises no uncalibrated flag, and writes gauge-skip.json reason 'subagent-transcript-missing'

constraints: Silence is acceptable; a confident wrong number is not.
The new skip reason costs zero engine change - add it at the call site only, do not touch gauge_reader.py.

m4.title: Invert the sidechain filter for a subagent, with agentId equality
m4.imperative: Give find_latest_usage and compute_record ONE agent_id parameter (not an expect_sidechain/expect_agent_id pair - an incoherent combination must be unrepresentable). agent_id None keeps today's filter exactly (skip isSidechain truthy). agent_id set requires the line to be isSidechain TRUTHY *and* carry a top-level agentId EQUAL to that agent_id - the equality is what makes a wrong derived path fail closed. The conjunct is unfalsifiable against tests/fixtures/real_subagent_transcript.jsonl (all 4 lines sidechain, same agentId), so ADD a derived fixture whose extra line carries the matching agentId with isSidechain falsy and assert it is skipped. Record the line count of each fixture and how many lines each assertion actually reaches. TDD red (c1) then green (c2).

preconditions.statement: m3 complete: subagent reads only its own derived transcript

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the polarity/equality tests and the derived fixture written and observed failing

default polarity on the real subagent fixture still returns None (existing assertion unedited); its own agent_id returns the real usage sum; a different agent_id returns None; the derived fixture's matching-agentId non-sidechain line is SKIPPED; reach counts measured

constraints: tests/fixtures/real_subagent_transcript.jsonl is real captured output - do not modify it; add a separate derived fixture.

m5.title: Record the identity-resolution duration on the written record
m5.imperative: Measure the identity-resolution step and record it on the gauge write as an optional fifth field, against the issue's 100ms placeholder budget. The reader validates its four required fields and tolerates extras. Because a no-agent_id payload must stay byte-identical (and a pre-existing test pins the record to exactly four keys), the field appears only on the subagent path - state that reasoning in the code. Prove it is a real measurement, not a constant: slow the identity step deliberately and assert the recorded value tracks it. TDD red (c1) then green (c2).

preconditions.statement: m4 complete: polarity inverted and equality enforced

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the duration-field tests written and observed failing

the duration appears on a subagent's written record, is within the 100ms budget, and demonstrably tracks a deliberately-slowed identity step; the four-key record for a no-agent_id payload is unchanged

constraints: gauge_reader.py and checklist_engine.py are NOT edited; the four required fields keep their meaning.

m6.imperative: Run the handoff's three required verification commands with real exit codes.
